content: Elixir projection GenServer lifecycle: projectors subscribe via EventStore persistent subscriptions (at-least-once, checkpoint-based) or PubSub (live only). Commanded uses a GenServer that on init sends :subscribe_to_events, subscribes with a name, start_from (:origin/:current/explicit), and receives events via handle_info. Checkpoint is stored in a projection_versions table (last_seen_event_number per projector name). error/3 callback controls retry (with optional delay), skip, or stop. On restart, resumes from last checkpoint automatically. Replay/rebuild requires resetting the checkpoint and restarting from :origin.
